units: local currency units per international dollar
note: Populated by `applicant rates --refresh`. Only values actually retrieved from the World Bank are recorded here - nothing is written from memory, because a wrong factor silently distorts every salary comparison rather than failing loudly. A currency that is mapped in money.CURRENCY_COUNTRY but missing below is fetched on demand at runtime, and falls back to a market rate flagged `ppp-unavailable` if that fetch fails.

USA.note: the international dollar is the US dollar
